---
name: Create CBW Auth Screen
description: 'Create or update a CBW login or registration screen from the authentication template patterns.'
argument-hint: 'Login or registration, enabled methods, error states, and redirect behavior.'
agent: agent
---

Use `create-cbw-screen` for new views or `update-cbw-screen` for existing ones. Inspect the v1/v2 authentication references, adapt their hierarchy to CBW, and preserve the current authentication, token, callback, and redirect behavior.
